title: Latest Time by Replacing Hidden Digits
summary: Given a time string in hh:mm format with some digits as ?, find the latest valid time between 00:00 and 23:59 by replacing the hidden digits.
statement: Given a time string in hh:mm format with some digits as ?, find the latest valid time between 00:00 and 23:59 by replacing the hidden digits.
constraints: pattern has HH:MM form with digits or question marks and admits at least one 24-hour time.
Replace every question mark to produce the latest valid time.
reference_solution:
def latest_valid_time(pattern):
 chars=list(pattern)
 if chars[0]=='?':chars[0]='2' if chars[1] in '?0123' else '1'
 if chars[1]=='?':chars[1]='3' if chars[0]=='2' else '9'
 if chars[3]=='?':chars[3]='5'
 if chars[4]=='?':chars[4]='9'
 return ''.join(chars)

hints: Earlier positions dominate lexicographic and chronological order.
Choose the largest digit that keeps each partially fixed field valid.
Resolve hour tens using hour ones, then hour ones using hour tens; set minute digits to five and nine.
Every choice is the largest feasible at the first still-unknown position, so no later valid time can exceed it.
